Sumadhura Epitome Overview

3 & 4 BHK Luxury Apartment

Tucked into the peaceful pockets of Rachenahalli, Sumadhura Epitome feels like North Bangalore's best-kept secret. We've built a Mediterranean-inspired design across 3.75 acres where greenery meets thoughtful design. Each of our 262 sunlit corner homes stands proudly on its own—giving you the privacy you've always wanted without those awkward shared walls.
Step inside our beautiful 2, 3 & 4 BHK residences where old-world Vaastu principles shake hands with today's comforts. From the moment you touch the doorknob, you'll notice the little things—those careful touches, the way light plays across your living room, how the breeze seems to find its way through every room. You can't explain it, but you'll know
Just 5 mins from Manyata Tech Park, Sumadhura Epitome lets you slip away from Bangalore's busy tech scene and business districts without actually going far. This isn't just another building project—it's a whole new take on city living.

Frequently asked questions

Where is the Sumadhura Epitome Located?

Located in North Bangalore's prime location near Thanisandra Main Road, Sumadhura Epitome offers excellent connectivity to Manyata Tech Park, Bengaluru International Airport, and major business districts. This Mediterranean-themed luxury project enjoys proximity to premier educational institutions and healthcare facilities, making it an ideal residential investment opportunity.

Which is the closest metro station to Sumadhura Epitome?

The upcoming Thanisandra Metro Station on the Pink Line is just 1.2 kilometers away, providing residents with seamless connectivity to key locations across Bangalore. This metro connectivity enhances both lifestyle convenience and property appreciation potential.

What is the total land area of Sumadhura Epitome?

Sumadhura Epitome is developed on a premium land parcel of 3.75 acres in North Bangalore, featuring thoughtfully designed spaces that balance built-up area with luxury amenities and landscaped gardens, embodying true Mediterranean architecture.

What are the types of residential units available at Sumadhura Epitome?

Choose from elegantly designed luxury apartments in multiple configurations:
2 BHK Premium apartments: 1290 - 1545 sq.ft.
3 BHK Luxury homes: 1580 - 1855 sq.ft.
4 BHK Ultra-Luxury residences: 2120 sq.ft.

Each premium residence features high-end specifications and modern amenities.

How can I book a site visit at Sumadhura Epitome?

Schedule your exclusive site visit through:
Sales helpline: 9403894402
Our property experts are available daily for personalized assistance.

Is Sumadhura Epitome a RERA-approved project?

Yes, Sumadhura Epitome is RERA approved, RERA No.: PRM/KA/RERA/1251/446/PR/190924/007044.

What makes Sumadhura Epitome stand out from other residential projects in Bangalore?

Sumadhura Epitome offers distinctive advantages:
Premium location in North Bangalore
Mediterranean-inspired architecture
Sustainable living features
Low-density project
Premium specifications
Backed by Sumadhura Group's 30+ years of excellence
Strong rental yield potential

How many units are available in Sumadhura Epitome?

The project features 262 exclusive apartments across 3 towers, ensuring optimal density and privacy. The limited units per floor design creates an intimate community atmosphere while maintaining exclusivity.

What is the completion date of the Sumadhura Epitome?

Scheduled for completion by Dec 2027, the project construction progresses with strict adherence to quality standards. Regular construction updates are shared with homebuyers, reflecting our commitment to timely delivery.
